name.es-ES: Tratado de la oración y meditación
name.en-US: A Golden Treatise of Mental Prayer
name.pt-BR: Tratado da oração e da meditação

description.es-ES: El manual de oración mental de san Pedro de Alcántara (c. 1556): siete meditaciones para los días de la semana, siete sobre la pasión, las seis partes de la oración, ocho avisos, y la segunda parte sobre la devoción, sus ayudas, estorbos y tentaciones. Las meditaciones de la primera parte se apoyan en el Libro de la oración y meditación de fray Luis de Granada.
description.en-US: St. Peter of Alcántara's handbook of mental prayer (c. 1556): seven meditations for the days of the week, seven on the Passion, the six parts of prayer, eight counsels, and a second part on devotion, its aids, hindrances and temptations. The meditations of Part I draw on Luis de Granada's Libro de la oración y meditación. English: G. S. Hollings's edition (1905), which differs from the Spanish in places (it abridges some meditations and lacks the dedicatory prologue).
description.pt-BR: O manual de oração mental de São Pedro de Alcântara (c. 1556): sete meditações para os dias da semana, sete sobre a Paixão, as seis partes da oração, oito avisos e a segunda parte sobre a devoção, seus auxílios, obstáculos e tentações.

en-US.translator: G. S. Hollings (ed., after the 1632 Willoughby translation)

sources.edition: Tratado de la oración y meditación, Documenta Catholica Omnia / MBS Library, modernised-orthography transcription (web capture of 2006).
sources.description: Complete Spanish text: prologue, Part I (12 chapters, with the 14 daily meditations) and Part II (5 chapters). Page furniture removed, chapters split.
sources.tierEvidence: The 16th-century text is in the public domain; DCO posts this transcription freely with no licence terms.

sources.edition: A Golden Treatise of Mental Prayer, ed. G. S. Hollings, London: A. R. Mowbray, 1905 (scan of the 1940 reprint). OCR.
sources.description: English chapters follow the Spanish ids. The appendices (Short Introduction, Three Things) are not included here. Hollings's scripture-reference footnotes are not kept (their markers are lost in the OCR).
sources.tierEvidence: Published 1905; the editor, G. S. Hollings, died in 1914.

sources.edition: Cross-check copies: the Apostolado Mariano (Sevilla 1991) scans on archive.org (tratado-de-la-oracion-y-meditacion-san-pedro-de-alcantara), and the Medina del Campo 1587 and Sevilla 1699 prints.
